title: AC1 - Login form is available at Signup/Login page

steps.expected: Homepage is loaded
Login form page is displayed

steps.step: Verify login form is visible with email and password fields
steps.expected: Login form contains email field, password field, and login button

title: AC2 - Valid credentials log user into the application

steps.expected: Login form is displayed
Email is entered in the email field
Password is entered in the password field
User is redirected to dashboard/homepage
User profile/dashboard is displayed with user information

title: AC3 - Invalid credentials show error message

steps.expected: Login form is displayed
Email is entered in the email field
Password is entered in the password field
Error message 'Incorrect credentials' or similar is displayed

steps.step: Verify user is not logged in
steps.expected: User remains on login page, not redirected

title: AC4 - Empty email field shows validation warning

steps.expected: Login form is displayed
Email field is empty
Password is entered in the password field
Validation error message appears for email field

title: AC4 - Empty password field shows validation warning

steps.expected: Login form is displayed
Email is entered in the email field
Password field is empty
Validation error message appears for password field

title: AC4 - Both empty fields show validation warnings

steps.expected: Login form is displayed

steps.step: Leave both email and password fields blank
steps.expected: Both fields are empty
Validation error messages appear for both email and password fields
